subject: Orbit Consulting — production connector incident & SLA runbook
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@orbitconsulting.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>; Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@orbitconsulting.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Production connector failure — immediate SLA coordination requested

Hi Camila / Sergio,

We're seeing intermittent 504s from the Redwood connector that routes requests from Orbit's integration tenant (orbit-prod-12). The errors started around 08:40 PDT and have affected ~12% of requests to our enrichment endpoint — customer impact includes delayed webhook processing. We opened a ticket on our side (ticket ORB-9142) but we need to align support coverage and an interim rollback plan.

Can Redwood provide:
- an on-call contact for partner escalations outside standard SLA hours?
- confirmation of current SLOs for connector availability and MTTR for partner integrations?
- a quick runbook or guidance for temporary mitigation (e.g., fallback URL or rate-limiting knobs)?

I'm attaching a short summary of the errors and a sample request/response.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Strategic Partnerships
Orbit Consulting
Attachments: orbit-errors-20260705.txt
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@orbitconsulting.com>, Orbit Consulting Support <support@orbitconsulting.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production connector failure — immediate SLA coordination requested

Jenna — thanks for the heads up and the sample payload. We’ve seen the same error surface in our telemetry (increased 5xx from the connector pool handling orbit-prod-12). I pulled logs and it looks like a memory pressure spike on one of the nodes that hosts the dedicated shard for Orbit; the autoscaler didn't rehydrate fast enough.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- I pinged infra on-call to spin a replacement node (ETA 20–30m).
- Sergio will coordinate with you on temporary backpressure settings you can apply client-side (small token-bucket tweak) so retries don’t amplify the failure.
- We’ll share a compact runbook and a proposed short SLA amendment for partner escalations by EOD.

Laura — looping you in for visibility; this might require a one-off credit if customer-facing impact is >1 hour.

Camila Reyes
Partner Success (Redwood Inference)
Camila.Reyes@redwood.ai
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@orbitconsulting.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production connector failure — immediate SLA coordination requested

Jenna — quick note with mitigations you can apply now:
1) Reduce parallelism from 10 -> 6 for the enrichment webhook consumer for 15 minutes.
2) Increase client-side retry backoff to exponential starting at 500ms with max 6 retries.
3) If you can route a small % (5%) of traffic to the secondary read-only endpoint (read-01.redwood.api), that will reduce load on the primary shard.

I’ll stay on this until the replacement node is healthy. I’ll also attach a one-page runbook (orbit-runbook-v1.pdf) with the above and validation steps.

—Sergio
SRE — Integrations
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachments: orbit-runbook-v1.pdf

On Sun, Jul 5, 2026 at 09:40, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jenna — thanks for the heads up and the sample payload...
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@orbitconsulting.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orbit Consulting Support <support@orbitconsulting.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production connector failure — immediate SLA coordination requested

Appreciate the quick response — Sergio, we applied the reduced parallelism and bumped retries per your notes. The 504s dropped immediately; we observed about a 90% reduction in error rate within 10 minutes.

Two asks from Orbit:
- Can we fast-track an SLA addendum that includes an overnight on-call layer for partner connectors (11pm–6am PT)? Our global customers hit different windows and we need a guarantee for escalation coverage.
- We would like Redwood to accept a short handshake process for in-flight credits when partner impact exceeds 1 hour. A post-incident audit is fine, but we need the ability to pause invoices if the outage is material.

Happy to take a short call today if helpful.

Tom Ellis
Head of Integrations
Orbit Consulting
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@orbitconsulting.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@orbitconsulting.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production connector failure — immediate SLA coordination requested

Tom / Jenna — thanks for the clear ask and for applying Sergio’s mitigations. I'm Laura (Head of Partnerships Operations at Redwood). We can move quickly here:

Proposed near-term commitments
- Nighttime partner escalation window (pilot): 11pm–6am PT, staffed by a rotating partner on-call (not yet 24/7). We'll commit to a 60-minute response SLA for incidents within that window during the pilot.
- Billing hold policy: we can implement an automatic provisional credit hold for incidents >1 hour affecting partner-integrated connectors; final credit amount will be reconciled after the post-mortem.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will draft an SLA addendum and run it by legal. (Marissa — can you have a draft to Orbit by EOD Wed?).
2) Camila will schedule a short sync (20m) to walk the addendum and the runbook.
3) We'll implement a temporary contact alias partner-oncall@redwood.ai and add Orbit to the escalation list for the pilot.

I'll attach a draft SLA template now (sla-amendment-draft.docx) and a link to the runbook folder. If that sounds good, we can get the pilot started this week.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Attachments: sla-amendment-draft.docx
